description.content:
Public, unauthenticated read access to the EnergyX merchandise catalog behind energyx.com/shop/, exposed twice: through the WooCommerce Store API (wc/store/v1), which is the anonymous storefront contract, and through the WordPress core product post type (wp/v2/product). Verified live at 15 products in 4 categories on both. The WooCommerce admin API (wc/v3) on the same host returns 401 to an anonymous caller and is deliberately not modelled.

 Name: EnergyX
